description.zh:
背景资源配置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见**BgImageConfig**。

><notice>当LayoutType取值为studio时，本参数才必填。
></notice>
description.en:
The configuration of the background resource. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see **BgImageConfig**.

><notice>

This parameter is required only when LayoutType is set to studio.

></notice>

description.zh:
导播台ID。
><notice>需要提前创建好，必须是虚拟演播厅类型的导播台。
></notice>


- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**页面查看。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
description.en:
The ID of the production studio. ><notice>The production studio must be created in advance and must be of the virtual studio type.></notice>

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId value returned in the response.

- If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the **ApsaraVideo Live console** > **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** page to view the ID.

> The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID.

description.zh:
通用布局配置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见**CommonConfig**。
><notice>当LayoutType取值为common时，本参数才必填。
></notice>
description.en: The configuration of the common layout. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see **CommonConfig**. ><notice>This parameter is required only when LayoutType is set to common.></notice>

description.zh:
图层顺序设置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见**layerOrderConfig**。
支持背景素材、多媒体素材排序，暂不支持抠像层。越排在前面，越在底层。
description.en: The layer order settings. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see **layerOrderConfig**. You can sort background and multimedia materials. Chroma keying layers are not supported. The earlier an item appears in the list, the lower its layer.

description.zh: 布局ID。如果您通过[AddStudioLayout接口](~~2848062~~)添加虚拟演播厅的布局设置，请查看AddStudioLayout接口调用返回的参数LayoutId值。
description.en: The ID of the layout. If you add a layout for a production studio by calling the [AddStudioLayout](~~2848062~~) operation, use the LayoutId value returned in the response.
The name of the production studio layout.

description.zh:
多媒体输入资源设置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见**MediaInputConfig**。

><notice>当LayoutType取值为studio时，本参数才有效，且为选填。
></notice>
description.en:
The settings for the multimedia input resource. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see **MediaInputConfig**.

><notice>

This parameter is valid and optional only when LayoutType is set to studio.

></notice>

description.zh:
抠像输入设置。格式为JSON字符串，请参见**ScreenInputConfig**。

><notice>当LayoutType取值为studio时，本参数才必填。
></notice>
description.en:
The settings for the chroma keying input. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see **ScreenInputConfig**.

><notice>

This parameter is required only when LayoutType is set to studio.

></notice>

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口修改虚拟演播厅布局。修改布局设置时，仅需传入要修改的参数。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to modify the layout of a production studio. When you modify the layout settings, pass only the parameters that you want to change.

## QPS limit

The QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second for each user. If you exceed the limit, API calls are throttled. This may affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation at a reasonable rate.
